description: Find a putter and straight midrange from one shop serving your shipping country. Use that country's currency for the disc budget. Availability varies by country. Shipping is separate.

budget.description: Disc budget before shipping in the currency of country_code, e.g. 50 USD for US. Use whole amounts for JPY.

budget_currency.description: Optional ISO currency code to confirm the budget currency. Must match the shipping country's currency.

budget_gbp.description: Legacy GBP budget for GB only. Supply either budget or budget_gbp.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 shipping country, e.g. US, GB, DE or JP.

language.description: Language of the builder page and affiliate disclosure.

name: build_starter_set
